title: Aṅga-upāṅga-astra-pārṣada-saṅge
author: from Gītāvalī by Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur

translation: In the company of His expansions (Nityānanda Prabhu and Advaita Āchārya), sub-expansions (Śrīvās Ṭhākur and other devotees), weapon (Śrī Harināma), and associates (Gadādhar Paṇḍit and other intimate companions), Gorā, the embodiment of divine love, dances in ecstasy.
Singing the Name which purifies the Age of Kali, the son of Śachī roams throughout the abode of Nadia.
